quote: Anago rice and oyster set meals are seasoned in the regional style, which relies on wheat-based soy sauce; no gluten-free preparation is documented.
found: 厳島膳 4500円（税込）・珍味・小鉢・刺身・蒸し牡蠣・かきフライ・あなご飯・お吸い物・香の物 ／ 瀬戸内膳 2800円 ・珍味・小鉢・牡蠣フライ・あなご飯・お吸い物・香の物 ／「ご予約頂ければ名物あなご料理をはじめ広島かきや瀬戸内の珍味などをふんだんに盛った膳をご用意いたします。」
note: The page does document the anago-rice and oyster set meals and the site carries no allergen or gluten-free statement anywhere, so the claim's substance holds — but the page never names soy sauce, and the record omits the harder, directly-documented wheat carrier printed on the same page: かきフライ／牡蠣フライ (panko-battered fried oyster) appears in 厳島膳, 瀬戸内膳 and the せとうち御膳. Name the fried oyster, not only the tare.

quote: The kitchen centers on conger eel, oysters and other seafood, so vegan diners should not assume any shared equipment or stock is free of animal products.
found: 「名物あなご料理をはじめ広島かきや瀬戸内の珍味などをふんだんに盛った膳」— all five documented 膳 list あなご飯 plus some of 刺身／蒸し牡蠣／かきフライ／お吸い物.
note: Directly supported: every documented set meal is anago/oyster/sashimi-based and お吸い物 is a dashi soup, so no plant-only route exists. Note the site's own 「※牡蠣の不作に伴い、蒸し牡蠣の提供が難しくなる可能性がございます」 substitution notice — content can change without notice. Trading status: open; page carries 更新日 2026年5月21日 and 2025年4月1日 prices.

quote: Oden is simmered in a single shared dashi pot seasoned with soy-sauce-based broth, so items share the same wheat-containing liquid.
found: 「丁寧にうま味を引き出した出汁で炊き上げるおでん。一つ一つ個性の違う食材だからこそ、下ごしらえはより丁寧に。個性の強い揚げ物は全て手作りし、そして湯通ししております。丁寧に丁寧に出汁を回しかけ、じっくりと時間をかけて美味しいおでんに育てるのがわいくの「おでん」です。」(/sp/oden.html)
http: 200 — https://www.oden-waiku.com/ redirects to /sp/ under an iPhone UA; the oden detail lives at /sp/oden.html
method: plain fetch with iPhone UA (desktop route also 200 via ?mode=pc)
note: The shared-pot mechanism is confirmed in the operator's own words (all items cooked in one dashi; 三種盛り／五種盛り／七種盛り), but the cited wording is wrong about WHY: the house describes its broth as a blend of 「昆布」「鰹」「シイタケ」「鶏ガラ」 and never mentions soy sauce. The documented gluten carriers are the house-made 揚げ物 (fish-cake items, 全て手作り), きつね, 牛スジ and the 唐揚げ. Re-point the citation at /sp/oden.html and lead with the fried items.

quote: The cuisine relies on dashi and soy-sauce seasoning typical of Japanese oden and sashimi; standard Japanese soy sauce contains wheat. No wheat-free soy sauce is documented.
found: 「地元瀬戸内海を中心とした鮮魚の刺身、広島の地物を使った煮穴子の炙り、海鮮料理、安芸高田市高宮町の広島赤鶏(高宮鶏)の唐揚げなどをご用意しております。お料理をより一層引き立てる自家製の柚子胡椒、味噌ダレも店主の拘りの一つ。」
note: Sashimi, 煮穴子 (simmered in a soy tare by definition) and 唐揚げ are all named on the cited page, and no wheat-free soy sauce is claimed anywhere on the site, so the 'none documented' half is solid. The site never prints the word 醤油 — the wheat attribution is the record's own general-knowledge inference. Two items the record should name: the house 味噌ダレ／ネギ味噌 served with the oden (miso is a routine wheat/barley risk) and the 唐揚げ.

quote: The house dashi is made with bonito (fish) and chicken bone in addition to kelp and shiitake, so even vegetable oden items are cooked in an animal-based stock.
found: 「和食の基本、そしておでんの味を左右する「出汁（だし）」は鰹、昆布、鶏ガラ、シイタケなど複数の出汁を掛け合わせてご用意しております。」— and on /sp/oden.html:「わいくで「昆布」「鰹」「シイタケ」「鶏ガラ」の4種をブレンドし、うま味を掛け算する」
note: Verbatim support on the cited page, in the operator's own words: bonito + chicken bone + kelp + shiitake in one blended stock that every oden item is simmered in. vegan_status 'no' is correct. Trading status: open — site advertises a 2026年6月7日 event and the shop's 4th anniversary on 1月12日; 17:30–23:30, 月曜日定休.

quote: Core dish is wheat noodles seasoned with a miso and soy-sauce base, so gluten is integral and there is no documented gluten-free handling.
found: 「まず、丼に肉みそから入れる。中にミンチ肉やみそ、練りごま、すりごまなどが一通り入っている。次にしょうゆだれを入れる。このしょうゆだれが味のポイント。」 and 「多加水麺で角ばった麺は口内で存在感を発揮する」
note: Chugoku Shimbun's own build-order description (2023-02-21) confirms wheat noodles over a miso + soy-sauce base, and the article contains no allergen or gluten-free mention. Worth adding: the article states lunch runs exactly 11:30–13:30 with the ticket machine switched off at 13:30, so there is no window in which a special preparation could be negotiated.

quote: The broth/seasoning is built on soy sauce (typically wheat-containing) layered with miso.
found: 「デリカセロリの汁なし担々麺のレシピでは、しょうゆだれに直接味を加えているため、スープで伸ばすことをしない。」／「特製しょうゆだれ … 玉ネギ、ニンジン、白ネギ、ショウガ、ニンニク、八角など根菜類から香味野菜に至るまで、低温で長時間加熱して味を抽出してあるのだ。」
note: Directly supported — the article calls the しょうゆだれ the point of the flavour and says it is deliberately undiluted (no soup to thin it), so the soy-sauce load per bowl is higher than a typical noodle dish, not lower. The wheat attribution of the soy sauce itself is the record's inference; the article does not break down the tare's brewing.

quote: Signature noodles are topped with miso-seasoned minced meat; no vegan preparation is documented.
found: 「丼の底には肉みそと特製しょうゆだれ」／「まず、丼に肉みそから入れる。中にミンチ肉やみそ、練りごま、すりごまなどが一通り入っている。」
note: Supported, with one wording fix worth making: the 肉みそ is laid in the BOTTOM of the bowl before the noodles, not 'topped' on them — 「ネギしか見えない。ネギの下にはすぐ麺があり、他の全ての食材はさらに麺の下にある」 — so it cannot be omitted or scraped aside, which makes vegan 'no' firmer than 'topped' implies.

quote: Okonomiyaki is made from a wheat-flour batter and topped with wheat noodles, all cooked on a single shared teppan griddle alongside every other order, so cross-contact with wheat is unavoidable.
found: Root page: every signature okonomiyaki lists 「そば or うどん」(電光石火／夢／たっぷりマヨネーズ／たっぷりチーズ／キングオブルーキー／ダンスナンバー). Branch page /shop/285/: 「全席カウンター・熱々鉄板で食べれるけえ！！」「カウンター席のみ22席」.
method: plain fetch + wp-json/wp/v2/faqpost enumeration for the allergen check
note: Substance holds, and the chain's full 18-item FAQ (pulled via wp-json) contains NO allergy or allergen question at all, which is what confirms 'no documented handling'. Defect to fix: the citation is the chain ROOT for a record about ONE branch, and a bare root cannot evidence this branch's single 22-seat counter griddle. Re-point to https://okonomiyaki-denko-sekka.com/shop/285/, which states it directly.

quote: Dishes are finished with okonomiyaki sauce, a wheat-based Worcester-style sauce; no wheat-free or gluten-free sauce is documented.
found: 「鉄板の熱気を感じながら、汗を拭い、ヘラで熱々を口に運ぶ。焼けたソースの香りが、さらなる食欲をかき立てる。」「ソース、生地、キャベツなど素材へのこだわりはもちろん」 plus 甘辛ソース and 激辛ソース in the menu blurbs.
note: The cited page confirms sauce is applied to every okonomiyaki and that no wheat-free or gluten-free variant is offered anywhere on the site; the 'wheat-based Worcester-style' composition is the record's own general knowledge, as the company publishes no ingredient list. Same root-vs-branch citation fix applies.

quote: The shared griddle is used continuously for pork, egg, squid, oysters, and other animal ingredients, so any item would have animal-product cross-contact.
found: Every okonomiyaki on the cited page lists 肉・玉子; sides include 「ハツのタレ焼き」「和牛ホルモン炒め」「牡蠣（ポン酢 or バター）」「豚もやし」「鶏もも肉おろしポン酢」「えびまよ！！」— all cooked on the same teppan.
note: Directly supported, and if anything understated: pork, egg, squid, oyster, prawn, wagyu offal, heart and chicken thigh are all named on the cited page, and the branch is counter-seating-only so every order crosses one griddle. vegan_status 'no' is correct. Branch trading status: open — /shop/285/ gives 10:00–23:00 (L.O 22:30), 定休日 なし.
